messages.author: abc790e1a87bc50a
messages.subject: HTML/PDF report via Shiny
parts:
Hi there,

I would like to generate a PDF or HTML report via Shiny, but I cannot seem to get the report displayed to the user.. The PDF just keeps loading, while the HTML just shows a link to a tmp file.. The reports are successfully created on the server, though..

The app is here: http://glimmer.rstudio.com/brechtdv/report/
And the code is here: https://github.com/brechtdv/report

Many thanks!
Brecht

messages.author: abc790e1a87bc50a
messages.subject: Re: HTML/PDF report via Shiny
parts:
By replacing 'file.rename()' with 'file.copy()', I am now able to get the PDF report, but the HTML version still just shows the path of a tmp file..
